answer_1.quote: Recent advances in pre-trained language models ... especially when they are fine‑tuned on downstream tasks such as summarization, data‑to‑text generation, long‑question answering, etc. ... we focus on prefix‑tuning and investigate ways to improve its generalization on text generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE‑1/2/L using Python rouge‑score ... We use the official evaluation script for BLEU, METEOR (Lavie and Agarwal, 2007), NIST, TER, MoverScore, BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Human annotation was conducted by 9 professional raters ... The judges are shown the original document, the ground truth summary and two model summaries ... The judges are then asked to compare two model summaries based on each of the five criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare model outputs pairwise and indicate which summary is better for each criterion (faithfulness, relevance, grammaticality, coherence, overall quality) or mark them as same.
